blocks.name: Callout, icon and text
blocks.description: A highlighted note with an icon, a title, text and an optional button. Copy this block to start your own: the root element needs the class b-<pack id>-<block id>, here b-example-callout, and its CSS lives in one @scope for that class inside @layer components.

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.help: A built-in icon name follows the site's icon set; set:name picks one icon.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.help: Text fields are escaped, so any characters are safe.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.default: Callouts draw attention to one important point, such as a deadline, a tip or a change in plans.
fields.help:
Line breaks become
through the nl2br helper.

fields.name: tone
fields.label: Tone
fields.help: Select and segmented values are good for data attributes the CSS can style.

fields.name: button
fields.label: Button
fields.help: Links always go through the href helper, so they follow page renames.

blocks.template:
{{#if icon}}{{svgIcon icon}}{{/if}}

{{title}}

{{#if text}}

{{nl2br text}}

{{/if}} {{#if showButton}}
{{button.label}}
{{/if}}
